scope.description: An optional compositional direction for a user-requested continuous neighborhood street or streetscape collage. Divide the supplied frontage into a user-chosen number of adjacent paper-cut vignettes, keep a street baseline visually connected across them, and reveal interior slices only in user-specified places. This adapts a sequence-of-neighborhood-scenes idea to new locations and counts; it does not prescribe Harlem, a six-panel format, or any source-work arrangement.
limitations: Activate only when the user requests an urban street or neighborhood collage.
Preserve the user-specified number and order of building fronts, people, activities, and scene segments.
Keep one readable sidewalk or street-edge anchor continuous across the vignettes, unless the user requests a discontinuous layout.
Show interiors only through windows or cutaway areas explicitly requested by the user; do not invent private activities.
Keep building facades and collage seams distinct enough that segment boundaries remain legible.
Do not default to six panels, Harlem, named neighborhood institutions, or the layout of The Block.

rules.applies_when: The user provides a street frontage or specifies the number of scene segments.
rules.instruction: Divide the frontage into the same number and order of user-specified adjacent vignettes; let cut-paper seams mark transitions without adding buildings or activities.
rules.observable: The requested storefront or building count remains recognizable, and each collage segment corresponds to the supplied sequence.
rules.reject_when: Extra facades appear, a requested segment disappears, or the sequence is rearranged into a copied fixed panel layout.
rules.avoid: default six panels, Harlem landmarks, named businesses, or copied scene order

rules.applies_when: Multiple street vignettes share one continuous urban frontage.
rules.instruction: Carry a sidewalk, curb, or street-edge color band through each cut seam so the separate paper scenes still read as one connected walk along the user's street.
rules.observable: The viewer can trace one continuous ground-level path across all requested segments despite visible collage boundaries.
rules.reject_when: The ground line stops without cause, jumps to a different street, or merges distinct building fronts into one facade.
rules.avoid: disconnected floating panels or a seamless photorealistic panorama

rules.applies_when: The user requests windows or cutaway views into specified interiors.
rules.instruction: Reveal shallow interior fragments only within the requested window or cutaway boundaries; retain enough facade edge and paper overlap to separate interior from sidewalk activity.
rules.observable: Each interior detail is framed by a readable opening and does not spill into adjacent street vignettes.
rules.reject_when: Unrequested rooms, private figures, or interior objects cross into the public street scene.
rules.avoid: arbitrary open-wall cutaways, invented private scenes, or full-building dollhouse views

joint_checks.instruction: Keep the user-defined sequence and number of street segments, connect them with one ground-level anchor, and show interiors only inside requested openings.
joint_checks.observable: Visible paper seams create separate neighborhood glimpses while the street remains one coherent user-defined place.
